defs.def: to choose sb/sth from a group of people or things, usually according to a system 选择；挑选；选拔

ex.s: This project will select 10 visual artists and 10 writers to create artwork that will be displayed on temporary signs along the multi-use path.
ex.t: 该项目将选出10名视觉艺术家和10名作家，创作将在多功能步道沿线的临时标牌上展出的作品。

ex.s: Once in your account, select Electronic Articles Received.

ex.t: 此外，你的父母也能参加专为家长挑选的研讨会，了解前沿科学。

ex.s: A single sugary treat, selected by the child, was placed on a table.
ex.t: 桌上放着一样由孩子自己挑选的含糖零食。

ex.s: Select their own coursework.
ex.t: 选择他们自己的课程作业。

ex.s: Which of the following books is the text most likely selected from?
ex.t: 这篇文章最有可能选自以下哪本书？

ex.s: Twenty-five Young Leaders are being selected every two years for a four-year period.
ex.t: 每两年选出25名青年领袖，任期四年。

ex.s: After successfully completing the 4-Week Learning Sprint, you will need to submit a plan for a sport﹣based project, which you will work on if selected as an IOC Young Leader.
ex.t: 在成功完成4周学习冲刺后,您需要提交一个基于体育的项目计划,如果被选为国际奥委会青年领袖,您将致力于该计划.

ex.s: Levine and his research team selected volunteers aged between 45 and 64 who did not exercise much but were otherwise healthy.
ex.t: Levine和他的研究团队选择了45至64岁之间不常运动但其他方面健康的志愿者。

ex.s: In the experiment, Goffin’s cockatoos were able to select the right tool for the job, in most cases, by visual recognition alone.
ex.t: 在实验中,Goffin的cockatoos能够选择合适的工作工具,在大多数情况下仅通过视觉识别.

ex.s: Selected from collections throughout the world, it is the first major exhibition of his work to be held in over forty years.
ex.t: 这些作品选自世界各地收藏，这是四十多年来首次举办他的作品大型展览。

ex.s: It is selected by the technologist.
ex.t: 它由技术员选择。

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
ex.t: 你的申请将由联合国教科文组织的经理审阅，并在我们的数据库中保留六个月。我们不会回复每一位候选人。如果被选中，会有经理与你联系。如果六个月内未收到任何更新，则意味着你的申请未获成功。

ex.s: The third book is Julio Cortazar’s Save Twilight: Selected Poems, because poetry.
ex.t: 第三本书是胡里奥·科塔萨尔的《拯救黄昏：诗选》，因为诗歌。

ex.s: Selecting works by famous playwrights.
ex.t: 挑选著名剧作家的作品。

ex.s: Students should read the list with their parents / carers, and select two activities they would like to do.
ex.t: 学生应和家长/监护人一起阅读清单，并选择两项他们想做的活动。

ex.s: For this purpose, select ripe bananas for freezing as they are much sweeter.
ex.t: 为此目的，请选择成熟的香蕉进行冷冻，因为它们更甜。

ex.s: People select digital texts randomly.
ex.t: 电子文本适合社交媒体。

ex.s: All you have to do is select the photos of healthy food.
ex.t: 你只需要选择健康食物的照片。

ex.s: Then you'll be able to train your brain to select healthy food in real situations.
ex.t: 然后你就能训练你的大脑在真实的场景中选择健康的食物。

ex.s: You might want to: • relax and make eye contact with the audience • use gestures when appropriate • vary your tone and volume 1 Select a representative from the group to deliver the speech to the class.
ex.t: 你或许想要：• 放松并与听众保持眼神交流 • 在适当的时候使用手势 • 变换你的语调和音量 1 从小组中选一名代表向全班发表演讲。

ex.s: Items are picked up at one of our libraries — the one you selected in the ILL Request Form.
ex.t: 物品在我们的一家图书馆取——即你在馆际互借申请表上选择的那家。

defs.def: to mark sth on a computer screen; to choose sth, especially from a menu （在计算机屏幕上）选定；（从菜单中）选择，选取

ex.s: In this “book of books,” artworks are selected and arranged in a way that emphasizes these connections between different eras and cultures.
ex.t: 在这本"书中的书"中，艺术作品的选取和编排方式强调了不同时代和文化之间的联系。

defs.def: carefully chosen as the best out of a larger group of people or things 精选的；作为 … 精华的；优等的

ex.s: What are the selected artworks about?
ex.t: 入选的艺术作品是关于什么的？

ex.s: Out of the thousands of applicants, eleven were selected, including a young woman from China.
ex.t: 在数千名申请人中，有11人被选中，其中包括一名来自中国的年轻女性。

ex.s: Lisa: As a member of the school volleyball team, I wasn't selected for the end-of-year competition.
ex.t: Lisa ：作为学校排球队的一员，我没有被选中参加年终比赛。
